content.value: The blade speed of a single ring impulse blading is 300 m/sec and the nozzle angle is 20º. The isentropic heat drop is 473 kJ/kg and the nozzle efficiency is 0.85. The blade velocity coefficient is 0.7 and the blades are syinmetrical. Draw the velocity diagram and calculate the followings for a mass flow rate of 1 kg/sec.
(i) The axial thrust on the blading,
(ii) Steam consumption rate for a mechanical efficiency of 90%,

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
